description.value: Don-O-Ray Farms is a family-owned farm market in Kelowna's Lower Mission with over 20 years of operation, growing and selling fresh-picked fruit, vegetables, and herbs including standout items like giant peaches, sweet corn, and purple cauliflower. Alongside fresh produce, the farm offers its Nature's Kitchen line of prepared products — jams, hot sauces, spice blends, and homemade pies — available for online order with farm pickup year-round. The full in-person market is open through the core of the cycling season, making it a practical fresh-food stop for riders touring the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from donorayfarms.com confirms an operational farm market at 3443 Benvoulin Rd, Kelowna, with fresh produce, prepared foods, and online ordering. No bike parking, water access, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. OSM name ('Don-O-Ray Farm Market') differs slightly from the website's primary branding ('Don-O-Ray Farmers Market'), and OSM carries no address or phone, both of which were sourced from the website contact page.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Don-O-Ray Farm Market' but the website consistently uses 'Don-O-Ray Farmers Market' and 'Don-O-Ray Farms'.
OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced solely from the website contact page and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
In-person market is seasonal; cyclists arriving outside the main season will find only online ordering with farm pickup available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established local farm market selling fresh produce through the core cycling season; a useful resupply stop for Okanagan touring cyclists despite the lack of confirmed bike-specific amenities.

wow_evidence: family-owned farm market in Kelowna's Lower Mission with over 20 years of operation
